annotations.title: Turn the app's emails on or off

description: Turns the app's outgoing emails (sends — on by default) and/or the new sign-in device notice (newSignIn — on by default) on or off. Send either or both; the other is left as it is. Before go-live it acts at once; once live, the founder approves it in the browser (request_email_switches).
name: set_email_switches
title: Turn the app's emails on or off
